_about: The note on a Today outfit that's on a current trend, for users who said trends matter a lot (4-5). core/today/trendNote.js picks one, the same all day for each outfit. {trend} is the trend's name from the /trends page, and {is} becomes "is" or "are" (the trend's "plural" setting). Start with {trend} to get a capital letter. Edit freely - keep at least one.
messages: {trend} {is} one of this season's big looks.
